assumptions.choice: A pattern uses 250 completed candles for the cup and 20 completed candles for the handle. The cup low must occur outside the first and last 20 cup candles; the highest highs in each 20-candle rim must be within 5% of the cup neckline. The handle low must remain above the cup low and within 10% of the neckline, and no handle high may exceed the neckline.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a U-shaped cup and a small declining or consolidating handle but does not define their measurable geometry.

assumptions.choice: The 250-candle cup plus 20-candle handle is treated as a completed 270-candle formation before the breakout candle.
assumptions.reason: This satisfies the stated minimum formation time of approximately 250 daily candles.

assumptions.choice: The neckline is the highest High within the 250-candle cup.
assumptions.reason: The upper boundary of the cup is specified but no calculation method is given.

assumptions.choice: A breakout requires the breakout candle Close to be above the neckline.
assumptions.reason: This implements the stated preference that the breakout candle close above resistance while providing an unambiguous price-break test.

assumptions.choice: The confirmation average is a 50-candle simple moving average of Volume including the breakout candle, as calculated by the specified 50-period indicator.
assumptions.reason: The specification names an average over the last 50 candles but does not state whether the current candle is excluded.

assumptions.choice: Risk per trade is 1% of current total account value, with share quantity floored to the smaller of risk-based and cash-affordable quantity.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits 1-2% but does not select one value; 1% is within the stated limit.

assumptions.choice: The position is closed when the bar Low is below the stored handle low.
assumptions.reason: The specification says price drops below the handle low without selecting an OHLC field; Low is the literal intrabar price test available from daily OHLC data.

assumptions.choice: Risk sizing uses the breakout Close although a standard market buy executes on the following bar and may fill at a different price.
assumptions.reason: The actual next-bar execution price is unknowable when the breakout signal is evaluated, so exact post-fill risk cannot be guaranteed using only the supplied daily OHLCV feed.
